note: Lightweight public backlog only. Completed or removed concepts are not kept here; full bot definitions remain private.

ideas.title: Coworker With Different Relationships for Different Alters (DID POV)
ideas.premise: A coworker gradually forms different relationships with different alters instead of treating the system like one interchangeable person.

ideas.title: An Alter Has Their Own Online Life (DID POV)
ideas.premise: One alter has built an online life of their own; the exact version of the setup still needs choosing.

ideas.title: The Tattoo Artist Stops the Second You Switch (DID POV)
ideas.premise: {{user}} consented to a tattoo, but a different alter fronts mid-session and does not; the tattoo artist immediately stops.

ideas.title: Someone in Your System Wants a Dog (DID POV)
ideas.premise: A DID POV concept centered on someone in the system wanting a dog; the exact character and opening setup still need finalizing.

ideas.title: The Teacher Who Adapts (DID POV)
ideas.premise: A DID POV concept centered on a teacher who learns to adapt to the system instead of expecting every alter to respond the same way.

ideas.title: The Coworker Who Remembers Your Good Days (DID POV)
ideas.premise: A DID POV coworker concept built around somebody who remembers the good days as well as the confusing ones; the exact opening still needs finalizing.

ideas.title: She Thought You Were Just Careful (OCD POV)
ideas.premise: She initially reads the routines, checking and hesitation as simple carefulness before realizing there is more behind it.

ideas.title: The Roommate Who Never Asks What the Nightmare Was (PTSD POV)
ideas.premise: A roommate responds to the aftermath of nightmares without demanding an explanation of what happened in them.

ideas.title: She's Going to Work, Not Leaving You (BPD POV)
ideas.premise: A relationship scene built around the difference between someone leaving for normal life and emotionally abandoning {{user}}.

ideas.title: Sleep Paralysis
ideas.premise: A sleep-paralysis-focused POV bot; the exact character and opening setup still need finalizing.

ideas.title: Shapeshifter Forgot Which Face Was Hers
ideas.premise: A female shapeshifter has worn other faces for so long that she no longer knows which appearance was originally hers. Separate from Vessa's mimic concept.

ideas.title: You Were Supposed to Stay Dead (Vampire x Immortal POV)
ideas.premise: A vampire who fed from {{user}} days or weeks earlier and believed the encounter was fatal recognizes them alive again. How {{user}} survives and what their immortality means stays user-defined.

ideas.title: The Siren Keeps Singing for You (AnyPOV)
ideas.premise: A siren's supernatural song cannot affect {{user}}, but they keep returning to listen anyway. She eventually starts singing because {{user}} genuinely enjoys it rather than because the song can control them.

ideas.title: Mermaid Picks the Wrong Target
ideas.premise: A mermaid-focused wrong-target concept where {{user}} is not the kind of target she expected; the exact reason and opening setup still need choosing.

ideas.title: Werewolf Pack Likes You
ideas.premise: A reversal of the earlier pack setup: the werewolf pack openly likes or admires {{user}}, while the alpha mostly just tolerates them.

ideas.title: Impossible Powers Partner
ideas.premise: An adult woman gradually discovers that {{user}} can turn invisible, teleport and stop time. The setup starts with discovery and trust rather than immediately using the powers for anything else.

ideas.title: The Dragon Hunter Realizes You're Only Half Dragon
ideas.premise: A dragon hunter closes in on {{user}} and realizes the target is only half dragon, complicating what was supposed to be a simple hunt.

ideas.title: The Lamia Keeps Offering You Her Warmest Spot
ideas.premise: A lamia repeatedly offers {{user}} the warmest, safest place in her coils; this may be merged with or focused around another lamia concept later.

ideas.title: The Dragon Princess Keeps Sneaking Out to See You
ideas.premise: A dragon princess keeps slipping away from court or her handlers for increasingly obvious visits with {{user}}.

ideas.title: The Elf Has Been Flirting With You for Months and Thinks You Know
ideas.premise: An elf has been openly flirting by her own cultural standards for months and only slowly realizes {{user}} has no idea.
